texts.text:
What if we could create something truly beautiful for our community?

For the past year, we’ve been calling in practitioners who resonate with a shared vision, and we now have a solid team of like-minded legends across multiple healing and wellness modalities, all eager to bring this dream to life!

Now, we’re looking for the land and the right people to help us make it happen. 🌱

🏡 WE’RE SEEKING A PROPERTY OF APPROXIMATELY 2 -3 ACRES OR MORE unused for us to create this vision on somewhere across the Redlands Coast and surrounding areas, from Murarrie and Wynnum through to Redland Bay and Mount Cotton.

It doesn’t have to be rural. We’re looking for space, potential and the right fit. We’re open to leasing, collaborating with existing landowners and businesses, developing a property, and we would eventually make enough revenue to be able to purchase the land if that’s the way the owners wished to go in the future.

And here’s where it gets exciting… ✨

🌿 OUR VISION FOR THE REDLANDS COAST

Imagine a thriving wellness destination where people can come together to nourish their minds, bodies and souls, reconnect with nature, learn, grow and build meaningful connections.

🧘‍♀️ A proper yoga shala with classes running throughout the day. Even this alone is something we feel is greatly needed in the Redlands — a dedicated space for regular movement, practice, connection and community.

🌱 An organic café serving nourishing food, fuelled by organic produce grown onsite and, ideally, through a partnership with Mount Cotton Organic Farm.

🌻 Productive gardens and food growing, bringing people closer to where their food comes from while creating a beautiful, sustainable environment.

🤲 A collaborative team of practitioners offering diverse healing and wellness modalities, alongside workshops, retreats, educational experiences and community gatherings.

💚 A space where practitioners can collaborate, support one another, build sustainable livelihoods and do meaningful work that genuinely serves others.

A natural chemical-free place to soak and enjoy magnesium rich waters with friends.

We believe the Redlands is such a special place for this vision to take root. With the ocean nearby, beautiful green spaces and room to create something unique, there’s an opportunity to offer our community something really special.

AND WHAT IF YOU ALREADY HAVE THE LAND?

Perhaps you own a beautiful property that you love and don’t want to sell or leave behind to downsize somewhere else. Maybe you’ve wondered how to make greater use of your land, generate income or create something meaningful with it.

We’d love to explore what a collaborative partnership could look like — bringing together your property and our passionate team, skills, services and vision to build something mutually beneficial.

You don’t necessarily need to sell your land for it to become part of something extraordinary. 🌿

DOES ANY OF THIS RESONATE WITH YOU? ✨

If you feel an affinity with these words, this vision or what we’re trying to create, please trust that feeling and reach out!

You don’t need to own land or have all the answers. Perhaps you know someone, have a connection, share our vision or simply feel curious about what we’re creating.

I’d genuinely love to meet up, have a cuppa and a chat, and explore the possibilities together. ☕💚

We’re currently based in Birkdale and would ideally love to find a central location to more easily be of service to the entire Redlands, but we’re open to wherever the right opportunity takes us.

Our mission is to bring this dream to life and be fully operational before 2030. The vision is clear, the team is formed and growing, and we’re ready to take the next steps. Similarly if you’re a practitioner reading this and would like to get on the train with us, please reach out :)

🌿 GET TO KNOW US

Explore our practitioner profiles below, learn about the people behind this vision and discover the modalities we offer:

📩 Contact Sera
📞 0491 309 571
✉️ wildewellco@gmail.com

If you know of suitable land, are interested in a property or business partnership, or simply feel called to connect, please reach out.

And if this speaks to you, please SHARE, SHARE, SHARE! You never know who might see this and help us find our future home.

Let’s grow something beautiful together. 🌱🌊✨

Need help deciding?

With so many practitioners and holistic therapies to choose from, it's completely natural to feel unsure about where to begin.

You don't need to have it all figured out — that's what we're here for.

Simply share what you're experiencing, what you'd like support with, or what you're hoping to achieve, and we'll thoughtfully connect you with the practitioner and therapy best suited to your unique needs.

Whether you're seeking relief from physical pain, emotional support, nervous system regulation, allergies, women's wellness, spiritual connection, or simply a moment to rest and restore, we'll help you find the right path within our collective.

Your journey is unique, and we're here to help you take the first step with clarity, confidence, and care.

Reach out today—we'd love to help you find your perfect practitioner. 🤍

texts.text:
The Wellness Collective is a living, breathing network of heart-centred practitioners, creatives, and facilitators who believe wellbeing is not one-size-fits-all — it’s personal, intuitive, and deeply human.

This collective was created to bring together like-minded practitioners who work with integrity, presence, and genuine care. 

Each offering within the collective stands on its own, yet all are woven together by shared values: authenticity, safety, respect, and a commitment to supporting people as whole beings — body, mind, heart, and spirit.

Rather than operating as a rigid clinic or hierarchical business, the Wellness Collective functions as a collaborative ecosystem. 

Practitioners are independent, sovereign in their work, and supported to show up as their fullest selves. This allows clients and community members to experience a diverse range of modalities, perspectives, and energies — all under one unified, values-led umbrella.

At its core, the Wellness Collective is about connection — to self, to others, and to something deeper than the day-to-day grind. It is a space where healing is not rushed, where intuition is honoured, and where people are met exactly where they are.

This is wellness that is grounded, ethical, and real.

This is community over competition.

This is collaboration over hierarchy.

The Wellness Collective exists to remind us that true wellbeing is cultivated together.
